mechanism.claim: Heavy two-way open-interest replacement with little net OI displacement is inventory transfer rather than simple leverage creation or liquidation. When the final completed hour escapes directionally at the onset of that cancellation state, follow the price direction for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the final completed-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: GOICR uses fixed-window total variation of log OI minus its net displacement: C=1-|sum d_i|/sum|d_i|. Existing OI candidates use net OI changes, OI-price divergence, purge, or departure-and-first-reclosure episodes. GOICR does not reuse round-trip episode settings, residual phase, signed inventory work, funding, premium, positioning ratios, or a prior diagnostic control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: high gross OI replacement plus a late directional escape is a leveraged volatile-auction state; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: new three-hour-grid cancellation onsets with twelve-hour reservation

features.oi_window: 73 exact BTCUSDT period=5m OI rows at timestamps [D-6h-5m,D-5m], producing 72 completed increments; each row positive and no imputation
features.cancellation: C=1-N/G, finite in [0,1] up to 1e-12 tolerance
features.late_escape: R=log(BTC close at D-5m / BTC open at D-1h), using exactly twelve complete coherent five-minute aggregates; strict nonzero
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midranks of G, C, N, and abs(R) over at most 720 prior valid exact three-hour decisions, minimum 480, current excluded
features.onset: current eligible state true and immediately preceding exact three-hour opportunity false; missing prior cannot trigger
features.availability: OI row timestamp D-5m and all price bars complete by D; entry one full five-minute bar later
features.source_valid: exact unique OI and price timestamp grids, positive finite OI/OHLC, coherent price bars, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: exact three-hour UTC boundary after source completion
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.one_decision_stale_churn: primary eligible boolean and side shifted by one exact three-hour decision with onset applied after shift

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no OI path, window, rank, history, onset, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
